notes: Easily the best of the vibe flavors. And not even close - a random blueberry flavored release turned out to be one of their best in the brand
body:
I don't really know what vibe means. I don't remember when I started seeing it, but I started out with the cosmic and oasis vibes. Cosmic was one of the few energy drinks I've ever spit out (I believe only two alongside Rockstar OG gold) so when I tasted arctic vibe I was VERY surprised. It was refreshing, not dry, and the right amount of sweet and sour to keep me going.

Overall taste: It is, at the end of the day, just a frozen blueberry drink. Tastes great cold. What makes this come together so well as one of my top 5 celsius flavors so far is that the way it's layered. When you first taste it, sour and carbonated. Then a good amount of sweetness hits. After that it gets washed away for the next sip. It's just a very pleasant experience. The taste is good, but the hydrating factor, mix of slight sour, sweet and subtle aftertaste make this one memorable.

Overall experience: Best suited for a working day. Can turn a crummy day into a great one with that first cold sip, and no need to keep water beside you all the time. Most versatile of the flavors in the sense that I have this when I'm at the gym, out doing chores, at work, at home. This one is rated highly for the experience, life versatility, and number of people it'll appeal to
name: Sparkling Arctic Vibe
